attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: pdf_text_extraction_and_structure_detection
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "pdf_reader_user"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_pdf
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/client/pdf/selected_file"
      description: "Receive the PDF file selected by the user in the browser"
    output: raw_pdf_data

  - id: step_validate_pdf
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_data
      schema: pdf_file_schema
      constraints:
        must_have_text_layer: true
        format: "application/pdf"
    output: validated_pdf

  - id: step_iterate_pages
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_pdf
      iterator: "page"
      description: "Load the PDF and iterate over each page"
    output: pdf_pages

  - id: step_extract_text_items
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: pdf_pages
      field: "text_items_with_font_size"
      description: "Extract all text items with their font size metadata from each page"
    output: raw_text_items

  - id: step_validate_text_items
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_text_items
      schema: text_items_schema
      required_fields:
        - "content"
        - "font_size"
        - "page_number"
    output: validated_text_items

  - id: step_compute_median_font_size
    op: aggregate_data
    params:
      input: validated_text_items
      group_by: "all"
      aggregation: "median"
      field: "font_size"
      description: "Compute the median font size to establish the body text baseline"
    output: median_font_stats

  - id: step_merge_text_with_median
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: validated_text_items
      secondary: median_font_stats
      join_key: "broadcast"
      description: "Attach median font size to each text item for comparison"
    output: text_items_with_baseline

  - id: step_apply_heading_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: text_items_with_baseline
      rule: "font_size_ratio_above_median"
      threshold_ratio: 1.2
      description: "Text items with font size significantly above the median are classified as headings"
    output: classification_results

  - id: step_transform_structure
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: classification_results
      mapping:
        headings: "items where classification == 'heading'"
        body_text: "items where classification == 'body'"
        structure: "hierarchical_document_tree"
      description: "Reshape classified text items into structured document with headings and body sections"
    output: structured_document

  - id: step_format_output
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: structured_document
      format: "json"
      locale: "fr-FR"
      description: "Serialize the structured document for the French-language academic reader"
    output: formatted_result

  - id: step_log_extraction
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_result
      event: "pdf_text_extraction_completed"
      details:
        processing: "client_side"
        language: "fr"
        method: "font_size_ratio_heading_detection"

  - id: step_notify_user
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: formatted_result
      message: "Extraction du texte et détection de la structure terminées avec succès."
      channel: "browser_ui"
dsl_type_errors: Step 'step_transform_structure': op 'transform_json' requires input of type 'records' but 'classification_results' has type 'boolean'. Make sure the step producing 'classification_results' uses an op that outputs a list of records (e.g. fetch_api, filter_records, validate_schema, read_database).
